title: cms.sitemap_entries
description: A provider of stapel-core's sitemap aggregator (stapel_core.django.sitemap; registered from AppConfig.ready()). Published, indexable (not noindex) pages then posts (posts only with BLOG_ENABLED) of one site, keyset-paged. Output: {entries: [{path (site-relative, no locale prefix), locale, kind: page|post, lastmod (ISO 8601), alternates: [{locale, path}] (indexable live variants of the translation group, itself included, when there are two or more; else [])}], cursor: string|null}. Pass cursor back for the next batch; null means done. limit defaults to 500.
